text:
Contact your pediatrician right away. A fever of 39.5°C (103°F) lasting two days plus unusual sleepiness needs professional evaluation—that's not something to dose at home without guidance.

Your pediatrician will:
- Rule out what's causing the fever
- Check whether ibuprofen is the right choice and at what dose for Mira's weight
- Decide if she needs to be seen

Call their after-hours line if it's outside office hours. If she becomes hard to wake, has a rash, difficulty breathing, or seems in pain, seek urgent care now.
